I sat down with Peter, the Co-Founder of Stronger, for a deep dive into the world of app development and building a successful app from scratch. With Stronger hitting 1M downloads, Peter shares his insights on mobile app development, mapping out an app development roadmap, and the importance of coding skills. This conversation is perfect for anyone curious about app development for beginners or looking to sharpen their programming knowledge.

We talk about the process for how to develop an app, and the steps for how to create an app that scales. If you’re into software development, full stack development, or crafting a winning business model, this podcast delivers practical, real-world advice.

Peter also shares tips on turning business ideas into reality, why now is a great time to make an app, and actionable strategies on how to make an app that users actually love. We dig into business ideas, explore new business ideas, and highlight best business ideas that have massive potential. And of course, you’ll leave with fresh, creative app ideas that could be your next big thing.
